title: 2.3.1 Data Science and Big Data
description: Interdisciplinary foundations of Data Science, the role of data scientists, Big Data dimensions (Volume, Velocity, Variety), and scale metrics.

questions.question: What is Data Science defined as in the curriculum?
options: A blend of tools, algorithms, and ML principles to discover hidden patterns
The manual transcription of paper ledger books into spreadsheet documents
The physical manufacturing of silicon wafers for integrated circuit boards
A diagnostic routine evaluating RAM failures through POST beep sequences
questions.correctAnswer: A blend of tools, algorithms, and ML principles to discover hidden patterns

questions.question: Which three disciplines intersect to form the field of Data Science (Figure 2.24)?
options: Computer Science, Mathematics, and Statistics
Mechanical Physics, Chemistry, and Geology
Microeconomics, Political Science, and Law
Sociology, Educational Psychology, and History

questions.question: What is the primary responsibility of a Data Scientist?
options: Using diverse algorithms to turn massive raw data into useful insights
Cleaning internal computer hardware components using low-flow vacuums
Soldering electronic microchips onto automobile assembly circuit boards
Drafting municipal legal regulations for commercial telecom monopolies
questions.correctAnswer: Using diverse algorithms to turn massive raw data into useful insights

questions.question: What is Big Data as defined in the textbook?
options: A huge volume of data that cannot be processed using traditional methods
A single database table containing more than one thousand records
A high-level programming script exceeding ten thousand lines of code
A magnetic storage disk with capacity greater than one gigabyte
questions.correctAnswer: A huge volume of data that cannot be processed using traditional methods

questions.question: Which three core dimensions characterize Big Data?
options: Volume, Variety, and Velocity
Voltage, Viscosity, and Vibration
Validity, Veracity, and Vector
Variable, Valuation, and Variance

questions.question: What does the 'Volume' dimension represent in Big Data architecture?
options: Data at Rest: terabytes to exabytes of existing data to process
The amplitude of acoustic audio frequencies during video calls
The physical thickness of internal hard disk aluminum platters
The number of characters printed across a single textbook page
questions.correctAnswer: Data at Rest: terabytes to exabytes of existing data to process

questions.question: What does the 'Velocity' dimension represent in Big Data systems?
options: Data in Motion: streaming data requiring milliseconds to seconds response
The maximum driving speed of autonomous vehicles along highways
The rotational speed of computer cooling fans in RPM units
The travel speed of electrical pulses along copper network wires
questions.correctAnswer: Data in Motion: streaming data requiring milliseconds to seconds response

questions.question: What does the 'Variety' dimension indicate regarding Big Data formats?
options: Data in Many Forms: structured, unstructured, text, and multimedia
The variety of programming language compilers installed on a server
The assortment of decorative font typefaces in HTML stylesheets
The range of electrical voltage plugs across different continents
questions.correctAnswer: Data in Many Forms: structured, unstructured, text, and multimedia

questions.question: How much data was generated daily by Facebook in 2020 as cited in the text?
options: 4 petabytes of data every single day
500 megabytes of data every single day
10 terabytes of data every single month
100 gigabytes of data every single year
questions.correctAnswer: 4 petabytes of data every single day

questions.question: In common digital storage units, what is 4 petabytes equivalent to?
options: One million gigabytes
One thousand gigabytes
Ten thousand gigabytes
One hundred thousand gigabytes

questions.question: Which combination of approaches does data science deploy to process big data?
options: Mathematical and statistical approaches paired with computer tools
Manual paper filing folders organized inside metal office cabinets
Analog vacuum tube amplifiers paired with manual switchboards
Electromechanical calculating wheels driven by hand-turned cranks
questions.correctAnswer: Mathematical and statistical approaches paired with computer tools
